name: Jubilee
overview: The biblical concept of Jubilee, as revealed in Leviticus 25, centers on the fiftieth year following seven cycles of seven years, a time when liberty is proclaimed throughout the land and each person returns to their family and possessions. This year, called the Acceptable Year of the Lord and the Year of Liberty, is marked by a holy rest where sowing and reaping cease, and the land's natural increase is shared. The sounding of the trumpet on the Day of Atonement signals this sacred time, emphasizing God's provision and restoration within the community through specific laws governing this special year.
